messages:
Tom R.: Heads-upDeloitte RFP team just returned the SIG - they want question-level evidence and a network diagram showing Hosted vs Dedicated. Can we assemble this quickly?

Jules H.: On it. Which SIG rows are they pressing on? ENC-3? NET-2? Data residency?

Tom R.: They flagged ENC-3 (at-rest encryption + KMS proofs), NET-2 (network segmentation), and CCC-1 (third-party SOC2). Also asked for an upload location and audit trail.

Anika S.: We should provide: SOC2 redacted pdf, KMS key rotation excerpt, minimal VPC diagram (no internal hostnames), and Dedicated deployment checklist. I can prepare the rotation excerpt.

Sam W.: I can sketch the VPC diagram and a short notes doc describing traffic flow and where crypto is enforced. Should we show subnet CIDRs?

Jules H.: Mask CIDRs. Show logical boxes: public LB, private inference pool, control plane (managed), and egress proxy. Mark security groups and KMS boundary.

Tom R.: Deloitte wants a secure upload (presigned S3 preferred) plus a manifest mapping SIG IDs to files. Deadline is Thursday COB for the first bundle. Can Security aim for Wed morning?

SecBot: Use Evidence Portal for external artifacts. Presigned links expire in 7 days. Uploads are logged to evidence-audit.

Anika S.: I'll redact ARNs and produce kms-rotation-redacted.json and ks-checksum.sha256 by Wed 09:00 PT.

Sam W.: Diagram ETA Wed 18:00 PT. Will include two versions: hosted_v1.svg and dedicated_v1.svg.

Jules H.: For ENC-3 evidence, include a small sample API snippet (redacted) showing envelope encryption call. Eg:

POST /v1/encrypt
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
Content-Type: application/json
{"key_id":"alias/placeholder-kms","data":"<base64>"}

Tom R.: Good. Also need a short statement re: on-site/air-gapped audits for Private deployments. Legal confirmation required. Can someone ping Legal?

Anika S.: Pinged Legal. They asked for the proposed audit scope; I'll loop Customer Ops and include the 30-day scheduling requirement.

Sam W.: Small operational question: do we version uploads? Deloitte asked about change control. I suggest filename suffix _v1 and a manifest with checksums.

Jules H.: Agreed. Manifest should be JSON mapping SIG IDs to filenames + sha256 strings.

Tom R.: SecBot, can you spin the presigned URL and set retention to 14 days? Deloitte wants download audit logs.

SecBot: Presigned URL created: https://evidence.redwood-inference.internal/upload/1769001234?exp=7d

SecBot: Retention: 14 days. Audit trail: evidence-audit index available to Procurement.

Tom R.: Great. I'll send the initial email after uploads. Please post when files are on the link.

Anika S.: Uploaded kms-rotation-redacted.json and kms-rotation_v1.sha256 to the URL.

Sam W.: Uploaded hosted_v1.svg and dedicated_v1.svg and network-notes.txt.

Jules H.: Uploaded soc2-redacted.pdf and manifest_1769001234_v1.json.

SecBot: Ticket SIG-3921 updated: 4 uploads, 3 downloads recorded.

Tom R.: Deloitte confirmed receipt and requested a 30-min walkthrough Friday 15:00 UTC. I'll add Security + Eng.

Anika S.: Legal replied: "High-level confirmation: Private/Dedicated deployments can be audited on-site under contractual terms; Legal will draft the clause." They requested we add a contact for scheduling.

Sam W.: Noted. I'll update manifest contact to security-ops@redwood-inference.internal.

Tom R.: Thanks everyone. We'll treat this as v1; if Deloitte asks for updates we'll produce v2 with diffs. :thumbsup:

Jules H.: End thread.
